description: This file defines the AbstractJob class, an abstract implementation of the Job interface, providing common functionalities for job management such as state transitions, execution handling, and transaction cleanup within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: AbstractJob
classes.description: An abstract class implementing core functionalities for jobs within the OFBiz framework, managing states, execution, and transaction safety.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the job.

methods.name: setCurrentState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the job.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Transitions the job to the QUEUED state if currently in CREATED state.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Reverts the job state from QUEUED to CREATED.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute job-specific logic, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the job, handles transaction cleanup, and records runtime.

methods.name: getRuntime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed execution time in milliseconds.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the job, defaulting to JobPriority.NORMAL.
